interpretation.label: f0_indeterminate
interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff F0 (LOAD-BEARING: the earliest edge, harm representation validity) reached a decisive verdict (F0_REPRESENTATION_HOLDS or F0_HSV_*) AND F1 (the chip's freeze on/off lock rule) reached a non-MIXED verdict. PASS means the edge was adjudicated, not that REE behaves. F3 is Q-111 leg-1 PRECONDITION DATA, never in the gate. Each leg's verdict is a majority (>= 2/3) of per-seed classes; F1's BOTH-collapse branch reads F0's verdict to separate saturation from other collapse.

preconditions.name: curriculum_reached_final_checkpoint
preconditions.description: fraction of seeds that completed the 935a curriculum (no stage abort).
preconditions.control: V3-EXQ-1107 reached the final eval on 3/3 of these seeds on this curriculum.

preconditions.name: f0_walk_samples_proximity
preconditions.description: fraction of seeds whose scripted walk gave >= 100 held-out ticks with nearest-hazard distance SD >= 0.75 (the R^2 target must vary or R^2 is undefined).
preconditions.control: a uniform random walk over the 4 moves in a 12x12 grid with 4 hazards (positive control: the target varies by construction unless lives are ~1 step).

criteria.name: F0_representation_validity_decisive
criteria.per_seed_statistic: held-out ridge R^2 of z_harm_a on capped nearest-hazard distance (ARM_WALK, final); measured = worst ready seed

criteria.name: F1_freeze_lock_on_vs_off
criteria.per_seed_statistic: LOCK: FZ_ON collapses (len <= 15.0 or stationary >= 0.9) with freeze_active >= 0.9, FZ_OFF does not

criteria.name: F3_veto_precondition_data
criteria.threshold_not_applicable: precondition data for Q-111 leg 1; classes, not a bar
criteria.per_seed_statistic: VETO_OFF entropy >= 1.0 bits; attributable divergence >= 0.5; hazard contact reduced >= 0.2

interpretation.f3_scope: Q-111 leg-1 PRECONDITION DATA, not a Q-111 test
interpretation.gate_input_independent_rule: min over the final scripted walk of ||z_harm_a|| >= theta_freeze on >= 2/3 reached seeds: the freeze EXIT (z < theta*tone, tone 1.0) is unreachable at every sampled input, so the lock is an operating-point SCALE fact (ARC-155 H1 site) whatever F0's R^2 says; a HOLDS verdict then does NOT by itself make ARC-155/ARC-156 PAG designs runnable.

dv_symmetry.F0_walk_vs_own: NOT INVARIANT: policy changes the sampled states; R^2 needs target variance.
dv_symmetry.F1_freeze_on_vs_off: NOT INVARIANT: removes the STAY override of the executed action.
dv_symmetry.F3_veto_on_vs_off: NOT INVARIANT: per-candidate safety axis changes the eligible set.

interpretation.premise_corrected: harm_obs_a in this harness is 7-d BODY DAMAGE (limb_damage_enabled=True, SD-022), not the proximity EMA the CeA re-probe measured; 1107 eval envs were seed-pinned to one spawn, this run uses a fresh paired seed per episode.
